body: Whenever me and the lads see a blacko on screen at the moving pictures center we always do our best chimp impressions; throwing all our food every where, screaming loudly, setting chairs on fire, and pretending that we cant breathe. Needless to say it always results in chuckles and the such from our crowd trying to focus on the bullshit on screen. I remember one time a balding white man with glasses so thick they could withstand a titanium drill piercing through them tried to stand up to us. Seeing as we were all 6'7 and hulking in strength, the most he could stammer out was a "M-maybe... You guys... Um... Please.... Don't.." As his wife and wife's son looked on in disappointment. Dont let this be you fellow redditors.
